normal_entry: Existing --repository-profile accepts optional diagnostics={kind:verify_snapshots_v1, expectation_root, compiler_output_roots, received_markers}. The shared backend binds this frozen policy for candidate checks and formal delivery.
behavior: Each check creates a fresh diagnostics directory outside source, copies the original expected snapshots without changing bytes, and supplies REPOFORGE_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOT/REPOFORGE_EXPECTATION_ROOT to the owned process. Only declared received names are accepted. Original files, copies and unexpected new source files are checked before accepting a result.

first_selection.cause: New test fixture expected literal LF although Windows write_text produced CRLF. Copies correctly preserved the original bytes; assertion changed to compare with the actual original. No production normalization was added.

normal_entry_and_delivery.scope: controlled normal CLI failed-check/revision/handoff plus completed-delivery and replay tamper rejection; no real model

existing_delivery_recovery.scope: retained failed Build, explicit delegation and applied-source recovery requiring fresh approval

public_feedback_consumer.scope: public feedback re-projection also rejects changed expected copies

verification.focused_review: Initial completed-delivery/replay omission was repaired using the same integrity helper; subsequent independent read-only review found no direct blocker.

actual_verify.feedback_observation: Actual TRX VerifyException includes received and verified FileContent. Existing bounded public projection and complete check_feedback_read retain diagnostic text; no new feedback tool required.

adoption_boundary: Shared diagnostic mechanism is usable under an explicit frozen profile and a bound test-runner adapter. Full1531 common-environment qualification and real B task results are still separate. Codex native tool round-trip remains independently unqualified.
return: Complete only the fixed remaining common-environment control list in final-environment-qualification-intent.json, then decide the registered standalone real B from the actual qualification result.
why: 为什么要有它：源码、测试、期望和诊断需要同一真实执行边界；通路修复和保留业务失败可以被证明，不能据此宣布模型修对或整套产品完成。
